summary.t: Set of six Christmas trees with a golden bell

text.t: Set of 6 little Christmas trees made of pine plywood; each piece features unique laser-engraved textures and a golden bell that brings a festive and magical sound to any setting, hanging from two twisted cotton strings in natural and red colours.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of small children, who may put it in their mouths.
